units.source_text: 我天天不苟言笑地照看著茂子，一邊還要應付各個雜誌社的約稿（

en.t: Day after day, I looked after Shigeko with a grim, unsmiling face, while also dealing with commissions from various magazines (

units.source_text: 除了靜子的雜誌外，其他幾家雜誌也開始斷斷續續地向我約稿，

en.t: Apart from Shizuko's magazine, several other magazines had begun asking me for work now and then,

units.source_text: 但都是比靜子的雜誌還要低俗的三流雜誌），

en.t: though all of them were third-rate magazines even more vulgar than Shizuko's,

units.source_text: 畫《金太郎與小太郎的冒險》，和明顯模仿《悠閒爸爸》的《悠閒和尚》，

en.t: drawing The Adventures of Kintaro and Kotaro, and Carefree Monk, an obvious imitation of Carefree Dad,

units.source_text: 以及《急性子小平君》這些標題飽含自暴自棄之意、連我自己都感到莫名其妙的連載漫畫。

en.t: along with serial comics such as Impatient Kohei, titles full of desperation that even I could not make sense of.

units.source_text: 我抑鬱重重，慢慢騰騰（我運筆的速度很慢）畫著這些漫畫，以此賺取喝酒錢。

en.t: Sunk in gloom, I drew those comics sluggishly, since my pen moved very slowly, and earned drinking money that way.
